topic: Getting your security deposit back vs losing it (Luis vs Tara)

scenes.narration: Landlords keep an estimated twenty seven billion dollars in security deposits every year. I am Judge Vera and today two renters fought back differently. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the bench holding a giant comic banner reading TWENTY SEVEN BILLION, courtroom spotlight on a stack of envelopes labeled DEPOSITS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Luis and Tara both move out of one thousand five hundred dollar apartments in the same city on the same Saturday.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two adults luis and tara moving boxes out of similar apartment doorways, both apartments numbered with rent flyers reading FIFTEEN HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Luis hands in the keys, takes no photos, and never sends a forwarding address or a written demand for his deposit back.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man luis dropping keys into a landlord's hand, an empty kitchen behind him with no photos taken, dust in the corners, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Tara photographs every wall, every appliance, and every floor before handing in the keys, then mails a written demand letter with her forwarding address.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman tara in an empty apartment holding a phone with photo gallery open, an envelope labeled WRITTEN DEMAND LETTER on the counter, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Thirty days later Luis gets a tiny check for one hundred dollars with vague deductions for cleaning, paint, and a missing curtain rod.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked man luis at a mailbox holding a check for ONE HUNDRED, a tiny paper labeled DEDUCTIONS LIST that lists eight items, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Tara gets one thousand four hundred and fifty dollars back because her photos proved every wall was clean. Same apartments, same landlord, very different results.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split scene, left side luis with a small check, right side tara holding a check stamped FOURTEEN FIFTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Photograph every room before you hand in the keys. Send a written demand within thirty days. The law is on your side. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel, holding a phone with a move out photo gallery, comic banner reads PHOTOS AND LETTERS, kids comic book illustration
